meta.cache_dir_note: CACHE_DIR='' (model cache disabled) in every compile-property set
meta.plateau_rule: heat loop on the pa prompt: stop when >=8 generations and the last 4 tpot values are each within 5% of their mean; cap 40
meta.warmup: 1 discarded generation per loaded arm on a neutral prompt unrelated to any cell
meta.multiturn_note: prior assistant turns are scripted, so prompts are byte-identical across arms/rounds
meta.prefix_cache_note: repeated identical prompts (heat loop, reps) hit the prefix cache on prefix-cache-ON arms (4b-prefix-cache, 9b-prefix-cache, 14b-ship)

header.kv_cache_precision: plugin default (unset, as in production default)

mde.formula: mde_tps = 2 * pooled_sd / sqrt(n); pooled_sd = sqrt(mean(sd_i^2)) over the per-(arm,cell) decode tok/s standard deviations that have n>=2; n = the smallest per-cell sample count. An effect in decode tok/s below this is not a finding.
